q25240.en: The minimum tread depth of a car's tyres must be 1.6 millimetres.

explain.short: 1.6 mm is the legal minimum tread depth for cars. Below it the tyre cannot push water away and grip is poor.
explain.rule: Car tyres need at least 1.6 mm of tread, motorcycles 1 mm. Tubeless tyres lose air slowly; tyres with an inner tube go flat fast.
explain.trap: '1,6 millimetri' is the correct value for cars; 1 mm is the value for motorcycles.

sceneParams.caption: Car tyres: at least 1.6 mm of tread
lines: Tread depth on a car tyre
Less: poor grip on wet roads

q25241.en: It is advisable to replace tyres after some years, even if they are not worn.

explain.short: Rubber gets old and hard with time, even when the tread is still deep. Old tyres grip less and can crack.
explain.rule: Car tyres need at least 1.6 mm of tread, motorcycles 1 mm. Tubeless tyres lose air slowly; tyres with an inner tube go flat fast.
explain.trap: 'anche se non sono consumati' (even if not worn): age alone is a reason to change them.

sceneParams.caption: Old tyres get hard: change them after some years

keywords.en: even if they are not worn

q25242.en: The minimum tread depth of a motorcycle's tyres must be 1.0 millimetre.

explain.short: For motorcycles (motocicli) the legal minimum tread depth is 1 mm. For cars it is 1.6 mm.
explain.rule: Car tyres need at least 1.6 mm of tread, motorcycles 1 mm. Tubeless tyres lose air slowly; tyres with an inner tube go flat fast.
explain.trap: 'motociclo' (motorcycle): the value 1,0 mm is right for motorcycles, not for cars.

sceneParams.caption: Motorcycle tyres: at least 1 mm of tread

q25243.en: If a nail has got stuck in a "tubeless" tyre, you can carefully keep driving, stopping as soon as possible to repair the damage.

explain.short: A tubeless tyre (without inner tube) loses air slowly, and the nail itself partly closes the hole. You can drive on carefully to a repair.
explain.rule: Car tyres need at least 1.6 mm of tread, motorcycles 1 mm. Tubeless tyres lose air slowly; tyres with an inner tube go flat fast.
explain.trap: 'con le necessarie cautele' and 'quanto prima' (carefully, as soon as possible): you go on, but only to get it fixed.

sceneParams.caption: Nail in a tubeless tyre: drive carefully to a repair

q25244.en: "Tubeless" tyres can be repaired only with special spray cans containing a sealant, which close the hole from the inside.

explain.short: Spray cans are only a quick emergency fix. A tyre repairer can also repair the tyre properly, so 'only' is wrong.
explain.rule: Car tyres need at least 1.6 mm of tread, motorcycles 1 mm. Tubeless tyres lose air slowly; tyres with an inner tube go flat fast.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only): spray cans are one way, not the only way.

sceneParams.caption: Spray can = emergency fix, not the only repair
lines: Proper repair at a tyre shop

q25245.en: In case of a puncture, "tubeless" tyres go flat slowly.

explain.short: A tubeless tyre has no inner tube: the rubber seals around the hole, so the air goes out slowly.
explain.rule: Car tyres need at least 1.6 mm of tread, motorcycles 1 mm. Tubeless tyres lose air slowly; tyres with an inner tube go flat fast.
explain.trap: 'lentamente' (slowly) is right for tubeless; a tyre with an inner tube goes flat fast.

sceneParams.caption: Tubeless tyre: loses air slowly

q25246.en: In case of a puncture, tyres with an inner tube go flat slowly.

explain.short: When the inner tube (camera d'aria) is pierced, the air escapes quickly, so the tyre goes flat fast.
explain.rule: Car tyres need at least 1.6 mm of tread, motorcycles 1 mm. Tubeless tyres lose air slowly; tyres with an inner tube go flat fast.
explain.trap: 'con camera d'aria' (with inner tube): this type goes flat fast; the slow one is tubeless.

sceneParams.caption: Inner tube tyre: goes flat fast

q25247.en: If a nail has got stuck in a "tubeless" tyre, you must pull it out at once, to stop the tyre from exploding.

explain.short: Leave the nail in: it partly plugs the hole. Pulling it out lets the air escape faster. The tyre will not explode.
explain.rule: Car tyres need at least 1.6 mm of tread, motorcycles 1 mm. Tubeless tyres lose air slowly; tyres with an inner tube go flat fast.
explain.trap: 'estrarlo subito' (pull it out at once): wrong, the nail must stay in until the repair.

sceneParams.caption: Leave the nail in until the repair
lines: It plugs the hole: go to a repair

q25248.en: Tyres inflated with nitrogen must be kept at a lower pressure than those with compressed air.

explain.short: Nitrogen only keeps the pressure steady for longer. The pressure value is the same one the maker gives for air.
explain.rule: Car tyres need at least 1.6 mm of tread, motorcycles 1 mm. Tubeless tyres lose air slowly; tyres with an inner tube go flat fast.
explain.trap: 'minore pressione' (lower pressure): wrong, the pressure is the same.

sceneParams.caption: Nitrogen or air: same tyre pressure

q25249.en: Studded tyres may be used only during a set period of the year.

explain.short: Studded tyres (pneumatici chiodati) damage the road surface, so they are allowed only in the winter period fixed by the rules.
explain.rule: Winter and studded tyres go on all wheels; studded ones only in a set period. Chains must be approved and come off on roads without snow.
explain.trap: 'limitatamente ad un predeterminato periodo' (only in a set period): correct, not all year.

sceneParams.caption: Studded tyres: only in the set winter period
lines: Allowed only in a set period

q25250.en: It is advisable to fit winter tyres on all the wheels.

explain.short: With winter tyres on only two wheels, the front and rear grip differently and the car can skid. Fit them on all four.
explain.rule: Winter and studded tyres go on all wheels; studded ones only in a set period. Chains must be approved and come off on roads without snow.
explain.trap: 'su tutte le ruote' (on all wheels): correct, not only on two.

sceneParams.caption: Winter tyres on all four wheels
lines: Fit them on all four wheels

q25251.en: Anyone using snow chains that are not approved can be fined as if they had none.

explain.short: Snow chains must be approved (omologate). Chains that are not approved count as no chains at all.
explain.rule: Winter and studded tyres go on all wheels; studded ones only in a set period. Chains must be approved and come off on roads without snow.
explain.trap: 'come se ne fosse sprovvisto' (as if they had none): correct, unapproved chains do not count.

sceneParams.caption: Unapproved chains = no chains
lines: Not approved: fined as no chains

q25252.en: Studded tyres must be fitted only on two wheels of the same axle.

explain.short: Studded tyres go on ALL wheels. On only two, front and rear grip differently and the car can skid.
explain.rule: Winter and studded tyres go on all wheels; studded ones only in a set period. Chains must be approved and come off on roads without snow.
explain.trap: 'solo su due ruote' (only on two wheels): wrong, they go on all wheels.

sceneParams.caption: Studded tyres go on all the wheels
lines: Fit them on all the wheels

q25253.en: On four-wheel-drive vehicles (so-called 4x4), snow chains must be fitted on the rear wheels.

explain.short: There is no rule that says 'rear wheels' for a 4x4. Follow the maker's manual, which says where to fit the chains.
explain.rule: Winter and studded tyres go on all wheels; studded ones only in a set period. Chains must be approved and come off on roads without snow.
explain.trap: 'devono... posteriori' (must... rear): wrong, the manual decides, not a fixed 'rear' rule.

sceneParams.caption: 4x4: fit chains where the manual says

q25254.en: The suspension parts are not damaged if you use tyres with chains on stretches of road without snow.

explain.short: On a road without snow, chains hit the hard surface and shake the car. This damages suspension, tyres and the road.
explain.rule: Winter and studded tyres go on all wheels; studded ones only in a set period. Chains must be approved and come off on roads without snow.
explain.trap: 'non si danneggiano' (are not damaged): wrong, chains on dry roads do damage them.

sceneParams.caption: No snow? Take the chains off
lines: Chains on a road without snow

q25255.en: Vehicles fitted with winter tyres must keep to lower maximum speed limits than the ordinary ones.

explain.short: Winter tyres do not change the speed limits of the road. The normal limits stay the same.
explain.rule: Winter and studded tyres go on all wheels; studded ones only in a set period. Chains must be approved and come off on roads without snow.
explain.trap: 'limiti... inferiori' (lower limits): wrong, there are no special lower limits for winter tyres.

sceneParams.caption: Winter tyres: normal speed limits

q25256.en: To change a wheel, it is best to park the vehicle on flat, firm ground.

explain.short: On a slope or soft ground the car can roll or fall off the jack. Flat, firm ground keeps it steady.
explain.rule: Flat ground, brake and gear on, passengers off the road. Loosen bolts before lifting, jack at the marked point near the wheel, tighten fully after lowering.
explain.trap: 'orizzontale e stabile' (flat and firm): correct, it keeps the jack safe.

sceneParams.caption: Change a wheel on flat, firm ground

q25257.en: Before changing a wheel, you must pull the parking brake and put the car in first gear or reverse.

explain.short: Parking brake plus a gear stops the car from rolling while it is on the jack.
explain.rule: Flat ground, brake and gear on, passengers off the road. Loosen bolts before lifting, jack at the marked point near the wheel, tighten fully after lowering.
explain.trap: 'prima marcia o la retromarcia' (first gear or reverse): correct, the gear holds the car.

sceneParams.caption: Parking brake on and a gear in
lines: Put in first gear or reverse

q25258.en: Before lifting the vehicle to change a wheel, it is advisable to loosen the fixing bolts slightly.

explain.short: With the wheel on the ground it does not turn, so the bolts are easy to loosen. In the air the wheel would spin.
explain.rule: Flat ground, brake and gear on, passengers off the road. Loosen bolts before lifting, jack at the marked point near the wheel, tighten fully after lowering.
explain.trap: 'allentare leggermente' (loosen slightly): correct, loosen, but do not remove yet.

sceneParams.caption: Loosen the bolts a little before lifting

q25259.en: While changing a wheel with the jack, you must avoid getting under the vehicle.

explain.short: The jack can slip and the car can fall. Never put any part of your body under a car held only by a jack.
explain.rule: Flat ground, brake and gear on, passengers off the road. Loosen bolts before lifting, jack at the marked point near the wheel, tighten fully after lowering.
explain.trap: 'evitare di mettersi sotto' (avoid getting under): correct, it is very dangerous.

sceneParams.caption: Never go under a car on a jack

q25260.en: To change a wheel, after lifting the vehicle and putting on the spare wheel, you must tighten the bolts lightly with the vehicle lifted and finish tightening them only after lowering it.

explain.short: In the air the wheel would turn, so you tighten lightly. With the wheel on the ground you can tighten fully.
explain.rule: Flat ground, brake and gear on, passengers off the road. Loosen bolts before lifting, jack at the marked point near the wheel, tighten fully after lowering.
explain.trap: 'solo dopo averlo abbassato' (only after lowering it): correct order of the job.

sceneParams.caption: Tighten lightly up, fully once lowered
lines: Spare wheel on, car still up
Lower the car, then tighten fully

q25261.en: In case of a puncture, before changing the wheel it is advisable to get all passengers out of the vehicle and, for safety, have them wait off the carriageway.

explain.short: People inside move the car on the jack, and people on the road can be hit. They wait off the carriageway.
explain.rule: Flat ground, brake and gear on, passengers off the road. Loosen bolts before lifting, jack at the marked point near the wheel, tighten fully after lowering.
explain.trap: 'fuori dalla carreggiata' (off the carriageway): correct, the safe place for passengers.

sceneParams.caption: Passengers out and off the road
lines: Everyone gets out of the car

keywords.it: far scendere dal veicolo tutti i passeggeri
keywords.en: get all passengers out of the vehicle

q25262.en: To remove a wheel that must be changed, you must take out the bolts before lifting the vehicle with the jack.

explain.short: Before lifting you only LOOSEN the bolts a little. If you take them out, the wheel is loose with the car on it.
explain.rule: Flat ground, brake and gear on, passengers off the road. Loosen bolts before lifting, jack at the marked point near the wheel, tighten fully after lowering.
explain.trap: 'togliere i bulloni' (take out the bolts): wrong, only loosen them before lifting.

sceneParams.caption: Loosen, do not remove, before lifting

q25263.en: To remove a wheel to be changed, you must place the jack at any point of the vehicle's side member.

explain.short: The jack goes only at the special points shown by the maker. Elsewhere the body can bend or the jack can slip.
explain.rule: Flat ground, brake and gear on, passengers off the road. Loosen bolts before lifting, jack at the marked point near the wheel, tighten fully after lowering.
explain.trap: 'in un punto qualsiasi' (at any point): wrong, only at the marked points.

sceneParams.caption: Jack only at the maker's marked points

q25264.en: To remove a wheel, you must place the jack as far as possible from the wheel to be changed.

explain.short: The jack goes at the marked point NEAR the wheel to change. Far away, the car tilts and is not stable.
explain.rule: Flat ground, brake and gear on, passengers off the road. Loosen bolts before lifting, jack at the marked point near the wheel, tighten fully after lowering.
explain.trap: 'il più lontano possibile' (as far as possible): wrong, it goes near the wheel.

sceneParams.caption: Jack near the wheel you change
lines: At the point near the wheel

q25265.en: Fitting the "space-saver" (a smaller spare wheel) lets you reach a speed of 120 km/h.

explain.short: The small spare wheel (ruotino) is only for a short trip to the tyre shop, at a low top speed written on it. 120 km/h is too fast.
explain.rule: Flat ground, brake and gear on, passengers off the road. Loosen bolts before lifting, jack at the marked point near the wheel, tighten fully after lowering.
explain.trap: '120 km/h': wrong, the ruotino has a much lower top speed.

sceneParams.caption: Space-saver: low top speed, not 120 km/h
lines: Low top speed shown on it

q25266.en: On vehicles with the "space-saver" fitted (a smaller spare wheel), carrying passengers is not allowed.

explain.short: With the ruotino you must drive slowly and carefully, but passengers may travel in the car.
explain.rule: Flat ground, brake and gear on, passengers off the road. Loosen bolts before lifting, jack at the marked point near the wheel, tighten fully after lowering.
explain.trap: 'non è consentito trasportare passeggeri' (passengers not allowed): wrong, there is no such ban.

sceneParams.caption: Space-saver: drive slowly, passengers OK

q25267.en: In an emergency stop, when the ABS comes into action, you must keep pressing the pedal hard, without easing the pressure.

explain.short: ABS (anti-lock braking) works only while you press hard. It stops the wheels locking, so you can still steer.
explain.rule: With ABS keep pressing hard. On long descents use a low gear, never neutral: hot brakes brake less. The parking brake is for a stopped car.
explain.trap: 'senza allentare la pressione' (without easing off): correct, keep pressing.

sceneParams.caption: ABS working: keep pressing hard
lines: Wheels do not lock, you steer

q25268.en: The braking effect of the engine is greatest in first gear.

explain.short: The lower the gear, the more the engine holds the car back. First gear gives the strongest engine braking.
explain.rule: With ABS keep pressing hard. On long descents use a low gear, never neutral: hot brakes brake less. The parking brake is for a stopped car.
explain.trap: 'massima... prima marcia' (greatest in first gear): correct, lowest gear = strongest.

sceneParams.caption: Engine braking is strongest in first gear

q25269.en: Long and repeated use of the brakes overheats them and makes braking less effective.

explain.short: Hot brakes work worse (this is called fading). Long, repeated braking heats them up.
explain.rule: With ABS keep pressing hard. On long descents use a low gear, never neutral: hot brakes brake less. The parking brake is for a stopped car.
explain.trap: 'diminuzione dell'efficienza frenante' (less braking power): correct, hot brakes are weaker.

sceneParams.caption: Overheated brakes brake less

q25270.en: On long, steep descents you must use a low gear to avoid overheating the brakes.

explain.short: In a low gear the engine helps to slow the car, so you use the brake pedal less and the brakes stay cool.
explain.rule: With ABS keep pressing hard. On long descents use a low gear, never neutral: hot brakes brake less. The parking brake is for a stopped car.
explain.trap: 'marcia bassa' (low gear): correct, the engine brakes for you.

sceneParams.caption: Long steep descent: use a low gear
lines: The engine helps, brakes stay cool

q25271.en: After washing the vehicle, it is advisable to do a brake test.

explain.short: Water can make the brakes wet and weaker. A gentle test tells you they work and helps dry them.
explain.rule: With ABS keep pressing hard. On long descents use a low gear, never neutral: hot brakes brake less. The parking brake is for a stopped car.
explain.trap: 'prova di frenata' (brake test): correct, wet brakes may work less.

sceneParams.caption: After washing: test the brakes

q25272.en: In an emergency stop, when the ABS comes into action, you must immediately reduce the pressure on the brake pedal.

explain.short: With ABS you must keep pressing hard. If you ease off, the car brakes less and stops later.
explain.rule: With ABS keep pressing hard. On long descents use a low gear, never neutral: hot brakes brake less. The parking brake is for a stopped car.
explain.trap: 'diminuire la pressione' (reduce the pressure): wrong, keep pressing hard.

sceneParams.caption: ABS working: do not ease off the pedal

q25273.en: All vehicles have a parking brake that is operated by hand.

explain.short: Many cars have an electric parking brake with a button, not a hand lever. So 'all... by hand' is wrong.
explain.rule: With ABS keep pressing hard. On long descents use a low gear, never neutral: hot brakes brake less. The parking brake is for a stopped car.
explain.trap: 'Tutti' and 'comando manuale' (all, by hand): wrong, some use a button or a pedal.

sceneParams.caption: Parking brake: lever, button or pedal

q25274.en: The parking brake is used while driving, to brake or stop the vehicle.

explain.short: The parking brake keeps a stopped car still. To slow down or stop while driving you use the brake pedal.
explain.rule: With ABS keep pressing hard. On long descents use a low gear, never neutral: hot brakes brake less. The parking brake is for a stopped car.
explain.trap: 'durante la marcia' (while driving): wrong, it is for a parked car.

sceneParams.caption: Parking brake = for a parked car
lines: It holds the car when stopped

q25275.en: On long, steep descents it is advisable to drive in neutral to save fuel and brakes.

explain.short: In neutral there is no engine braking: the car speeds up and the brakes overheat. Use a low gear.
explain.rule: With ABS keep pressing hard. On long descents use a low gear, never neutral: hot brakes brake less. The parking brake is for a stopped car.
explain.trap: 'in folle' (in neutral): wrong, it is dangerous; use a low gear.

sceneParams.caption: Downhill: never in neutral, use a low gear

q25276.en: After an accident, if there is a risk of the vehicle catching fire, it is advisable to switch off the electrics by turning the ignition key.

explain.short: Turning the key off stops the engine and the electric current, which can start or feed a fire.
explain.rule: Switch off the ignition; with no extinguisher use sand, earth or a wet blanket. Never empty or remove a fuel tank. The inertia switch lowers the risk.
explain.trap: 'spegnere il quadro' (switch off the ignition): correct, it lowers the fire risk.

sceneParams.caption: Fire risk: turn the ignition off

q25277.en: If a vehicle fire is starting and there is no extinguisher, you can throw sand or earth at the base of the flames.

explain.short: Sand or earth covers the fire and takes away its air. Aim at the base of the flames, where the fire starts.
explain.rule: Switch off the ignition; with no extinguisher use sand, earth or a wet blanket. Never empty or remove a fuel tank. The inertia switch lowers the risk.
explain.trap: 'alla base delle fiamme' (at the base of the flames): correct, that is where to aim.

sceneParams.caption: No extinguisher: sand or earth on the base
lines: Aim at the base of the flames

q25278.en: After an accident, if a vehicle fire is starting and there is no extinguisher, you can use a wet blanket to put out the flames.

explain.short: A wet blanket covers the flames and stops the air reaching them, so a small fire goes out.
explain.rule: Switch off the ignition; with no extinguisher use sand, earth or a wet blanket. Never empty or remove a fuel tank. The inertia switch lowers the risk.
explain.trap: 'coperta bagnata' (wet blanket): correct, it smothers the fire.

sceneParams.caption: No extinguisher: a wet blanket can help
lines: Cover it with a wet blanket
No air: the fire goes out

q25279.en: After an accident, if a vehicle fire is starting, you must empty its fuel tank immediately.

explain.short: Emptying the tank near a fire spreads fuel and makes the fire much worse. Never do it.
explain.rule: Switch off the ignition; with no extinguisher use sand, earth or a wet blanket. Never empty or remove a fuel tank. The inertia switch lowers the risk.
explain.trap: 'svuotarne... il serbatoio' (empty the tank): wrong, it is very dangerous.

sceneParams.caption: Never empty the fuel tank near a fire

q25280.en: After an accident, the risk of a fire is higher if the vehicle has an inertia switch, which cuts off the fuel supply to the engine.

explain.short: The inertia switch cuts the fuel after a crash. Less fuel flowing means a LOWER fire risk, not higher.
explain.rule: Switch off the ignition; with no extinguisher use sand, earth or a wet blanket. Never empty or remove a fuel tank. The inertia switch lowers the risk.
explain.trap: 'è maggiore' (is higher): wrong, the switch lowers the risk.

sceneParams.caption: Inertia switch cuts fuel: less fire risk
lines: Fuel to the engine is cut

q25281.en: After an accident, if a fire is starting in a vehicle that runs on LPG, you must remove the fuel tank at once.

explain.short: Removing an LPG (GPL) tank during a fire is impossible and very dangerous. Move away and call the fire brigade.
explain.rule: Switch off the ignition; with no extinguisher use sand, earth or a wet blanket. Never empty or remove a fuel tank. The inertia switch lowers the risk.
explain.trap: 'smontare subito il serbatoio' (remove the tank at once): wrong, never do it.

sceneParams.caption: LPG car on fire: never remove the tank

q25282.en: It is not advisable to put objects under the driver's seat, so that they do not slide while driving and get in the way of the driver's movements.

explain.short: An object under the seat can roll under the pedals and block the brake. Keep that space empty.
explain.rule: Nothing must distract you or block the pedals: phone only hands-free, no SMS, satnav set before moving. Message panels can also give orders.
explain.trap: 'sconsigliabile' (not advisable): correct, objects there are a danger.

sceneParams.caption: Nothing under the driver's seat
lines: It can slide under the pedals

q25283.en: Using a mobile phone without hands-free or an earphone is forbidden while driving.

explain.short: While driving you may use the phone only with hands-free or an earphone, so both hands stay on the wheel.
explain.rule: Nothing must distract you or block the pedals: phone only hands-free, no SMS, satnav set before moving. Message panels can also give orders.
explain.trap: 'senza... viva-voce o... auricolare' (without hands-free or earphone): that use is forbidden.

sceneParams.caption: Phone only with hands-free or earphone

q25284.en: When carrying children, it is advisable to switch on the safety device that stops the doors being opened from inside the vehicle.

explain.short: The child lock stops children opening the rear doors while the car is moving.
explain.rule: Nothing must distract you or block the pedals: phone only hands-free, no SMS, satnav set before moving. Message panels can also give orders.
explain.trap: 'consigliabile' (advisable): correct, the child lock protects children.

sceneParams.caption: Children on board: use the child lock

q25285.en: The air conditioner can usefully be used in winter too, to clear the windscreen quickly.

explain.short: The air conditioner dries the air, so the mist on the windscreen goes away fast, also in winter.
explain.rule: Nothing must distract you or block the pedals: phone only hands-free, no SMS, satnav set before moving. Message panels can also give orders.
explain.trap: 'anche nel periodo invernale' (in winter too): correct, it is useful all year.

sceneParams.caption: Air conditioner clears a misted windscreen

q25286.en: While driving, you are allowed to use the mobile phone to write text messages.

explain.short: Writing an SMS takes your eyes and hands off driving. It is forbidden.
explain.rule: Nothing must distract you or block the pedals: phone only hands-free, no SMS, satnav set before moving. Message panels can also give orders.
explain.trap: 'consentito' (allowed): wrong, writing messages while driving is forbidden.

sceneParams.caption: No text messages while driving

q25287.en: The satellite navigation systems in some vehicles must be programmed while the vehicle is moving.

explain.short: You program the satnav before you set off, with the car stopped. Doing it while driving distracts you.
explain.rule: Nothing must distract you or block the pedals: phone only hands-free, no SMS, satnav set before moving. Message panels can also give orders.
explain.trap: 'mentre il veicolo è in movimento' (while moving): wrong, program it when stopped.

sceneParams.caption: Program the satnav before you move

q25288.en: Variable message panels give warnings of danger but cannot have the force of a rule (an obligation or a ban).

explain.short: Variable message panels can show dangers AND orders or bans, such as a lower speed limit. Those orders must be obeyed.
explain.rule: Nothing must distract you or block the pedals: phone only hands-free, no SMS, satnav set before moving. Message panels can also give orders.
explain.trap: 'non possono avere valore prescrittivo' (cannot be binding): wrong, they can.

sceneParams.caption: Message panels can also give orders and bans
lines: It can also give orders or bans

q25289.en: When the road is wet, if the vehicle in front throws up water that dirties my windscreen, I must overtake it immediately.

explain.short: With dirty glass you see less: an overtake now is risky. Keep more distance and use the wipers and washer.
explain.rule: Nothing must distract you or block the pedals: phone only hands-free, no SMS, satnav set before moving. Message panels can also give orders.
explain.trap: 'sorpassarlo immediatamente' (overtake it at once): wrong, increase the distance instead.

sceneParams.caption: Spray from the car ahead: drop back
lines: Wet road, spray on the glass

q25290.en: Stickers, pendants or other objects attached to the vehicle's windows can reduce the driver's visibility.

explain.short: Objects on the glass cover part of what you see and can hide a pedestrian or a car.
explain.rule: Keep the glass clean and free: change worn wiper blades, keep washer liquid, repair a broken windscreen. Dust goes with washer and wipers.
explain.trap: 'possono ridurre' (can reduce): correct, they block your view.

sceneParams.caption: Keep the glass free of stickers and pendants
lines: They hide part of the road

q25291.en: Clear and clean side windows ensure better visibility outside.

explain.short: Clean, clear glass lets you see the road and other users well.
explain.rule: Keep the glass clean and free: change worn wiper blades, keep washer liquid, repair a broken windscreen. Dust goes with washer and wipers.
explain.trap: 'migliore visibilità' (better visibility): correct, clean glass helps you see.

sceneParams.caption: Clean windows: better view

q25292.en: You must check the wiper blades and replace them if they are worn.

explain.short: Worn wiper blades leave streaks of water on the glass, so you see badly in the rain.
explain.rule: Keep the glass clean and free: change worn wiper blades, keep washer liquid, repair a broken windscreen. Dust goes with washer and wipers.
explain.trap: 'se sono consumate' (if worn): correct, worn blades must be changed.

sceneParams.caption: Worn wiper blades: replace them

q25293.en: You must check that the windscreen washer tank always contains liquid for cleaning the glass.

explain.short: Without washer liquid you cannot clean dirt or spray from the windscreen while driving.
explain.rule: Keep the glass clean and free: change worn wiper blades, keep washer liquid, repair a broken windscreen. Dust goes with washer and wipers.
explain.trap: 'sempre' (always) is right here: the tank should never be empty.

sceneParams.caption: Keep the washer tank filled

q25294.en: If the vehicle's windscreen is damaged or broken, you must repair it with clear sticky tape.

explain.short: Tape does not repair a windscreen and blocks the view. A damaged windscreen must be repaired or replaced properly.
explain.rule: Keep the glass clean and free: change worn wiper blades, keep washer liquid, repair a broken windscreen. Dust goes with washer and wipers.
explain.trap: 'nastro adesivo' (sticky tape): wrong, it is not a repair.

sceneParams.caption: Broken windscreen: repair or replace, no tape

q25295.en: If the windscreen is covered with dust, you must use the demisting device.

explain.short: The demister only clears mist inside the glass. Dust outside is removed with the washer liquid and the wipers.
explain.rule: Keep the glass clean and free: change worn wiper blades, keep washer liquid, repair a broken windscreen. Dust goes with washer and wipers.
explain.trap: 'disappannamento' (demisting): wrong tool, it does not remove dust.

sceneParams.caption: Dust: use washer and wipers, not demister
lines: Demister: no, it is for mist

q25296.en: For greater safety, you must use only tyres of the sizes set in the vehicle's approval.

explain.short: The approval (omologazione) lists the tyre sizes that are right for the car. Other sizes can change braking and grip.
explain.rule: Approved sizes, same tyres on one axle, maker's pressure on all wheels. Low pressure wears the edges and heats the tyre; swapping tyres is useful.
explain.trap: 'esclusivamente' (only): correct here, only the approved sizes.

sceneParams.caption: Only the tyre sizes in the approval

q25297.en: For greater safety, the wheels on the same axle must have identical tyres.

explain.short: Different tyres on one axle grip differently, so the car pulls to one side when braking or turning.
explain.rule: Approved sizes, same tyres on one axle, maker's pressure on all wheels. Low pressure wears the edges and heats the tyre; swapping tyres is useful.
explain.trap: 'stesso asse' (same axle): correct, both sides must match.

sceneParams.caption: Same axle: identical tyres

q25298.en: For greater safety, you must also check the condition of the tyres on the sides, to prevent sudden blowouts or deflation.

explain.short: Cuts or bulges on the sides of a tyre can make it burst. Check the sides, not only the tread.
explain.rule: Approved sizes, same tyres on one axle, maker's pressure on all wheels. Low pressure wears the edges and heats the tyre; swapping tyres is useful.
explain.trap: 'anche sui lati' (also on the sides): correct, the sides matter too.

sceneParams.caption: Check the tyre sides too
lines: Cuts and bulges: risk of bursting

q25299.en: To ensure the vehicle's grip and stability, you must check that the tyre pressure is the one recommended by the manufacturer.

explain.short: The right pressure keeps the whole tread on the road, for good grip, braking and stability.
explain.rule: Approved sizes, same tyres on one axle, maker's pressure on all wheels. Low pressure wears the edges and heats the tyre; swapping tyres is useful.
explain.trap: 'consigliata dalla casa costruttrice' (recommended by the maker): correct, that is the value to use.

sceneParams.caption: Tyre pressure: the maker's value

q25300.en: Tyre pressure that is too low causes abnormal wear on the edges.

explain.short: With low pressure the tyre sags and rests on its edges, so the edges wear fast. Too high pressure wears the centre.
explain.rule: Approved sizes, same tyres on one axle, maker's pressure on all wheels. Low pressure wears the edges and heats the tyre; swapping tyres is useful.
explain.trap: 'ai bordi' (on the edges): correct for low pressure.

sceneParams.caption: Low pressure wears the edges
lines: The tyre rests on its edges

q25301.en: You must never swap the position of the tyres, so that they can adapt better.

explain.short: Swapping tyre positions (front and rear) helps them wear evenly and last longer. So 'never' is wrong.
explain.rule: Approved sizes, same tyres on one axle, maker's pressure on all wheels. Low pressure wears the edges and heats the tyre; swapping tyres is useful.
explain.trap: 'mai' (never): wrong, swapping tyres is useful.

sceneParams.caption: Swapping tyres helps even wear

q25302.en: To ensure the vehicle's grip and stability, you must check the tyre pressure only on the driving wheels.

explain.short: All tyres hold the car on the road, so check the pressure on ALL wheels, not only the driving ones.
explain.rule: Approved sizes, same tyres on one axle, maker's pressure on all wheels. Low pressure wears the edges and heats the tyre; swapping tyres is useful.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only): wrong, check every wheel.

sceneParams.caption: Check the pressure on all the wheels

q25303.en: To improve the cooling of the tyres, you must lower the inflation pressure.

explain.short: A tyre with low pressure bends more and gets HOTTER, not cooler. Keep the maker's pressure.
explain.rule: Approved sizes, same tyres on one axle, maker's pressure on all wheels. Low pressure wears the edges and heats the tyre; swapping tyres is useful.
explain.trap: 'diminuire la pressione' (lower the pressure): wrong, low pressure heats the tyre.

sceneParams.caption: Low pressure heats tyres up
lines: No: the tyre bends and heats up

q25304.en: Tyre pressure that is too low causes abnormal wear of the centre and of the edges.

explain.short: Too low pressure wears only the EDGES. The centre wears with too HIGH pressure.
explain.rule: Approved sizes, same tyres on one axle, maker's pressure on all wheels. Low pressure wears the edges and heats the tyre; swapping tyres is useful.
explain.trap: 'della parte centrale e dei bordi' (centre and edges): wrong, low pressure wears the edges only.

sceneParams.caption: Low pressure: edges wear, not the centre
lines: Centre wears: no, that is too high
